maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The three visible keypoints in the uppermost row are spaced at intervals approximately 1.5 times their own diameter, positioned at a roughly 15-degree dorsal angle relative to the primary vibrissae row immediately below.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95% melanin saturation; the visible surface of the rhinarium is predominantly comprised of low-luminance dark pixels with no significant pink or pale pixel clusters.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A continuous convex contour connecting the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip, forming an approximate 35-degree angle relative to the horizontal axis of the mandible.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark pigmentation visible on the posterior edge of the pinna and at the mandibular-maxillary junction.
